entries.test: CoreWeave's guarantees, insolvency proceedings and creditor recoveries would establish whether it must make creditors whole following SPV collapse.
entries.note: The surrounding sentence supplies the collapse condition.

entries.test: Company financial statements and SPV financing disclosures would show whether these debts are excluded from the companies' balance sheets.
entries.note: The balance-sheet qualification gives 'hide' a concrete accounting meaning.
The compound claim principally expresses concern and an evaluative comparison. Its legality component is separately checkable.

entries.test: Provider capacity allocations, customer contracts and annual compute spending would establish the claimed concentration and identify other customers exceeding $50 million annually.
entries.note: An estimate is not automatically probability language. The search statement is limited to what he found.

entries.test: Compute providers' customer revenues and contracts would show whether large-scale demand is limited to four or five companies.
entries.note: The customer-count explanation supplies a plain reading of 'diverse demand.'

entries.test: Market-wide customer spending, Meta's available capacity and commercial terms would show whether insufficient diversified demand explains its reliance on Anthropic.
entries.note: This asserts an economic constraint with observable implications.

entries.test: Customer spending shares, hyperscaler contracts and OpenAI's and Anthropic's financial disclosures would establish demand concentration and their ability to fund continuing commitments.
entries.note: The long-term affordability assessment is tied to their current finances.

entries.test: GPU specifications, sales assumptions and the stated power and revenue calculations would establish whether the projected sales imply the claimed capacity and required annual revenue.
entries.note: He evaluates the implications of NVIDIA's prediction rather than independently promising those sales.
The compound estimate explicitly includes Anthropic 'likely' spending a similar amount.

entries.test: Data center customer revenues and the two AI companies' cash flows, financing and compute commitments would establish the claimed dependence on annual fundraising.
entries.note: Context identifies the two companies as OpenAI and Anthropic.

entries.test: Demand relative to the described buildout and subsequent defaults, insolvencies or closures would show whether most AI data centers and their SPVs collapse under insufficient demand.
entries.note: The surrounding capacity calculations anchor the demand condition.

entries.test: Sightline's capacity figures, later project announcements and customer spending data would establish the capacity-to-demand ratio under the stated assumptions and OpenAI's and Anthropic's demand share.
entries.note: A conditional calculation about current plans remains an observation.

entries.test: Planned and financed capacity compared with paying compute demand, alongside lending and investment records from both periods, would test the asserted overinvestment and shared drivers.
entries.note: The surrounding discussion grounds the comparison in financing and demand.

entries.test: Data center leases, customer commitments and disclosures of uncontracted capacity would establish whether all facilities have locked-in demand and identify its documented sources.
entries.note: He rejects the universal-demand assertion; the normalization preserves that rejection and his search qualification.
'Borders on childish' supplies no testable standard for the models.

entries.test: NVIDIA's investments and backstops, neocloud financing disclosures and independent customer demand would show whether its support materially created an inflated appearance of compute demand.
entries.note: The asserted financing mechanism is publicly testable.

entries.test: Project debt defaults, insolvencies and repayment records would establish whether AI data center debt projects collapse as predicted.
entries.note: The explanation is causal, but the principal commitment is an inevitable future collapse.
He describes possible mechanisms of market disruption, with 'most likely' and 'perhaps' qualifications. The next sentence supplies 'perhaps both.'

entries.test: If most AI data centers go unused, aggregate debt recoveries and write-offs would establish whether investors lose at least 80% of invested funds.
entries.note: The scenario supplies an explicit antecedent.

entries.test: Financial institutions' loan impairments and liquidation sales of Hopper and Blackwell GPUs would establish the breadth and size of losses and resulting salvage values.
entries.note: The exceptionally broad institutional scope is present in the source.

entries.test: Following ten to fifteen data center loan defaults, debt prices, credit spreads and financing availability would show whether an industry-wide financial panic follows.
entries.note: The financial context gives 'panic' an observable market meaning.

entries.test: Reserve requirements and market reactions to several billion dollars of failed data center deals would establish the premise and whether those failures trigger a severe unwinding of AI investments.
entries.note: The reserve-requirement premise can already be checked independently.
The predicted pattern is explicitly 'much more likely.'
Capacity purchases are observable, but the compound claim assigns hyperscalers a private perception-management motive.

entries.test: If these hyperscalers stop expanding capacity, subsequent market reactions and data center debt issuance would establish whether financing shuts down as predicted.
entries.note: The cost of further construction is separately checkable.
The assertion that marketing and manufactured appearances are its only purposes concerns exclusive private motives.

entries.test: The agreement's covenant terms and OpenAI's financing and payment records before its delayed IPO would establish the consequences of three months' nonpayment and its need for additional funds.
entries.note: The covenant prediction has an explicit nonpayment condition; the cash-shortfall prediction has no precise deadline.

entries.test: Annual AI compute demand by July 22, 2029, and the survival or collapse of the financed buildout would test whether avoiding his predicted crisis requires hundreds of billions of dollars of demand.
entries.note: He specifies a necessary condition for his thesis to fail, not a promise that this demand will arrive.
The normalization adds an explicit causal link between adjacent assertions. The affordability sentence is framed as a judgment of absurdity.
Calling a belief ridiculous does not faithfully translate into an explicit four-year forecast that it will not happen.

entries.test: Operational, insolvency and debt-default records would establish whether the vast majority of AI data centers collapse when they must earn paying compute revenue.
entries.note: 'When' identifies the expected stage of collapse rather than an uncertain antecedent.

entries.test: AI data center closures, insolvencies and debt defaults would establish whether the vast majority collapse.
entries.note: The preceding paragraph supplies the referent of 'this.'

entries.test: Media coverage, subsequent investment and valuation changes, and household financial exposure would test whether the specified coverage consistently increases speculative investment and risk to millions of people.
entries.note: The universal 'every time' makes the claim demanding to substantiate, but does not remove its empirical content.
Attempts to plead complexity are firmly predicted, but the compound claim explicitly hedges who will make them.
